newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China optical fibre maker plans IPO.
newsitem.headline: China optical fibre maker plans IPO.

text.p: China optical fibre maker Jiangxi Optic Fibre Co Ltd plans to apply for an initial public offering of 45 million A shares for listing on the Shenzhen bourse, a company spokesman said on Friday.

The company, which is seeking the approval of the China Securities Regulatory Commission, wants money to expand production of telecommunications optical fibre, the spokesman told the China Securities Bulletin, a Hong Kong-based newsletter, today.
The firm, based in Ji'an city in the southeastern province of Jiangxi, is selecting an underwriter, the official said.

The company, with total share capital of 55 million shares, estimated 1996 net profits at about 15 million yuan compared with an actual 13 million yuan in 1995 and about 10 million yuan in 1994, the official said.
He said that earnings growth was fuelled by efforts to upgrade production technology.
